content.summary: Independent exact-integer checks reproduce both contradiction margins: the two-star residual count is at most 40 for every possible overlap size, and Profile A needs at least 24 two-outsider rows while its final fiber bound allows at most 20. The newly frozen SAT records substantiate only the stated UNKNOWN nonresult, with an explicitly relaxed encoding. Existing local proof assurance remains unchanged and accurately limited.
